title: Multivariate monotone cumulants as moment sums over Schroder trees weighted by skeleton Murua coefficients
author: Octavio Arizmendi; Adrian Celestino
source_title: Monotone Cumulant-Moment Formula and Schröder Trees
difficulty_reason: The proof lifts the moment character to the decorated Schroder-tree Hopf algebra and analyzes its convolution logarithm. Its new combinatorial step identifies the surviving iterated cuts with strictly order-preserving surjections of the skeleton, producing the Murua coefficients with all multiplicities. Pulling that logarithm through the coalgebra morphism gives the multivariate formula without a multiplicative Mobius inversion, which is unavailable for monotone cumulants.
source_version: Official SIGMA 18 (2022) article 073, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2022.073; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: Complete author Theorem1.1 proof and essential new Propositions5.1 and Lemmas5.10–5.11 are included. Work in the stated noncommutative probability space (A,phi), for every positive n and ordered list a1,...,an; no traciality or commutativity is assumed. ST(n), noncrossing partition pi(t), skeleton sk(t) and the strict-order-surjection definition of the Murua coefficient are all bundled. Existing double-tensor and decorated-tree unshuffle/Hopf structures and their morphism iota are explicitly prior results [5,7,14], not counted as new supports. The new cut-surjection bijection and full convolution coefficient proof are present; regrouped noncrossing, free and Boolean consequences are contextual only.
